description: A hand-written Inspect eval log (log.json): task refund_policy, two epochs reduced by mode, three scorers (letters C, I and P; numbers with a grader_failed NaN; a map of a letter and a number), a refusal reason, explanations, answers, case content (text and chat messages), usage per role and model with a grader role, a sample that failed before it was scored, reductions, and results with accuracy, mean, stderr and max. from-inspect imports it twice: with content kept (run/: blobs and evidence for the case content, explanations as reasoning blobs) and with --content-capture off (run-off/: no blob, and no explanation or answer, RUN-11). Both are sealed as ingest, with what the converter supplied in imported.asserted (IN-6). The summary is recomputed from the lines and equals Inspect's accuracy and mean (IN-9). Each file under refusals/ changes one thing the page refuses (IN-6 to IN-10).
